title: ID0471680-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP/S7170003860] User bent cooling cable
description:
Reported behavior/issue: user bent cooling cable
Solution: As aligned with Product Care:
Cable is too far bent, cooling can not be guaranteed. Needs to be exchange
Note from TS: Since cable was damaged by customer I believe this is out of warranty.

additional_info.subject: ID0471680-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP/S7170003860] Cable  Issue CRM:03289000207
additional_info.body:
Hello Luís, good afternoon :) I hope you are ready for the next ticket.
We got this ticket from RC-AT where the customer looks like he bended the DC cable.
I send the photos in attachment in order avoiding losing quality.
From my POV, this is "vandalism" or even user damage which will not be covered by warranty. As you can see from the photo, the customer just grabbed the cable as far as he could and bended it.
Now the real question is, "
Are you sure that we should replace the cable? In Austria we have the calibration law (ERK charger), and if we replace the cable, it must be recalibrated. At the moment the charger seems to be running without any problems.
Does Siemens have any experience with kinked cables? Do they lead to problems immediately, or is it only a cosmetic issue?
Do we have any official statement on these kind of situations? For sure this might not be affecting now, but for sure in the future.
Thank you a lot for your support.
Best regards,
Francisco
